translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Maenoan Lazarus
Erhai mwaaen itan Lazarus iwe eno Bethany a semwaai noa. Bethany itaen eew aepinoamw iwe Maria we pwiin Martha re nonno ee. (
Ieen iiy Maria we e aekkitiw neoningas wooan pirheen Soamwoon nge a toafi noa chogin reen aennirhimwen; nge man semwaai we Lazarus nge mwengeyan.)
Rhooapwut pwipwi kkewe ra fangenoa eew kkepas reen Jesus nge re iura pwe, “Soamwoon, maereyaer aecchaeng we oamw iye a semwaai.”

Igiwe Jesus a rongorong miniwe nge a iura pwe, “Amwiucchiunoan semwaai een nge saapw reen maenoan Lazarus; minneei nge a wen pwe epwe pwaeri noa minna nningen Deus, pwe ina nge mwaaen na Naiun Deus epwe yo ngaeni minna nningen.”
Jesus e aerhaengi Martha me miniwe pwiin me Lazarus.
Igiwe e itto kkepas we reen Jesus pwe Lazarus a semwaai, iwe a pwan no aegini mwo riiuraaen.
Iwe a aengaeni rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Sa pwan sefaaen noa Judea.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Sinsei, esaaen ssiunaei mwo aar aeremesaen iginaan menaen repwe teroag, nge wa pwan mwerhaen sefaaen noa?”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Eraaen nge seig me ruwowu awa noan, aere? Iwe rhooakkena re faaeraeg noan seremaen raaen ina resoapw toroppiung, pwe ra weri minna seremaen faeinaengiy.
Iwe nge aere re faaeraeg nee pwoong nge repwe toroppiung, pwe esooar seram.”
Jesus e aepesa miniwe nge a pwan iura pwe, “Lazarus we maereyaererh nge a maiur noa, ipwene noa pwe ipwe noa faingitae.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra iura pwe, “Soamwoon, ngaere igine e maiur, nge iiy ina epwe cchipw sefaaen noa.”
Jesus e aengaeniir pwe Lazarus a maenoa, nge iir re maengiy pwe e kkepesaen aan maiur.
Iwe Jesus a aeffeta ngaeniir pwe, “Lazarus a mae,
nge aegin aaemi minne egacch tipaei iga ise no reen Lazarus, pwe aaemi oawpwe niugiuniug. Sa noa reen.”
Thomas (iwe repwan gaen iura pwe Nippwei) a aengaeniir rhooa kkayeo kkewe aaemweoi pwe, “Oawsa tapweei noa Sinsei pwe sipwe noa rhag mae nong wooan!”
Jesus Iiy Minne Menaw Sefaaen me Menaw
Igiwe enoa tooto Jesus a itto weri pwe a fapwoong mwirin aan nipwaenipw noa Lazarus.
Bethany nge ese yo mwo nge ruwowu miles saengi Jerusalem,
iwe nge re igin towunap re Judea rhooan itto emwaeriir Maria me Martha reen maen mwaaen we mwengeyeer.
Igiwe Martha a rongorong pwe Jesus a itto, a itiwow pwe a itiwow rhuungi, nge Maria eno rhag nee iimw.
Martha a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Soamwoon, aere igine wono igeei nge mwaaen e mwengeaei esoapw mae!
Nge i giuneei pwe igina mwo nge Deus epwe ngaenneog ese tiwegin minne wo tingoareei.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Mwaaen mwu mwengeyoamw epwe menaw sefaaen tae.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Ngaang i giuneei pwe wooan minna oarosaen raaen nge epwe menaw sefaaen tae.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Ngaang minne menaw sefaaen me menaw. Iyo kka re niugiuniug ngaeniaei nge repwe menaw, inamwo igine ra mae noa;
iwe iyo kka re menaw nge re niugiuniug ngaeniaei nge esooar faaen eew ne repwe mae. Wo niugiuniug ngaeni minneei?”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Ooa, Soamwoon! Ngaang i niugiuniug pwe een Kristus iwe Naiun Deus iwe epwe itto noan faeinaengiy.”
Jesus a Saeng
Mwirin aaen Martha aepesa minneei, a sefaaen a noa faingi mwoanomwoanei Maria we pwiin. A aengaeni pwe, “Sinsei a no igeei, iwe nge e aekkaeyiyeg een.”
Igiwe Maria e rongorong miniwe, a iutae rhag nge a gucchuwow reen Jesus. (
Jesus esaaen toori mwo aepinoamw we, pwe e rhiuwen no igiwe Martha e rhuungi me ee.)
Rhooawe reno reen Maria noan iimw we ra pwan tapweei wow igiwe e iutae pwe epwene noa. Re niuwaennei pwe epwene noa reen paeyi we pwe epwe noa saeng me ee.
Maria enoa tooto igiwe Jesus eno ee, igiwe rhag eweri, nge e foatotiw me weni mmwan a aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, aere igine wo fasiun no igeei nge mwaaen we mwengeaei esoapw mae!”
Jesus eweri aan saeng, me pwan aeremas kkewe repwan tapweeito aar pwan saeng; iwe a gin tiwto waeiraesiy nee tipan me aenneewaen nee rhiun.
A aeiineeor pwe, “Iya iga oaw paeia me iya?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, itto wopwe noa weri.”
Jesus a saeng.
Aeremas kkewe ra iura pwe, “Oawweri nepaen aan aerhaengi!”
Aaemweoi ra iura pwe, “Iiy miniwe e aeffeta noa mesaen erhai masparh, aere? Esoapw mmwen aan epwe feeori pwe esoapw mae Lazarus?”
Jesus a Aemenewaetae Lazarus
A pwan gin tiwto aenneewaen nee tipaen Jesus, igiwe a noa reen paeyi we, iwe eew ngat me peigin eew rhug, iwe eno eew fai temoag reen asaeman.
Jesus a akkiuneeor pwe, “Peniy noa fai mwu!” Martha iwe mwengeyaen mwaaen we a mae a iura pwe, “Soamwoon, epwene aenneew pwoon, pwe a fapwoong pwongin aan nipwaenipw noa!”
Jesus aengaeni pwe, “Isaaen aengaeniug pwe wopwe weri minna nningen Deus igine wo niugiuniug?”
Ra peniy noa fai we. Jesus a fattae naaeng nge a iura pwe, “Wa aerhigerhig Semaei, reen oamw aiussaening mwaeniaei.
I giuneei pwe wogaen aiussaening ngaeniaei rhag, nge i aepesa minneei pwe aegiir aeremas kka igeei, pwe repwe niugiuniug pwe een minne wofangeto ngaang.”
Mwirin aan aepesa minneei nge a kkepas temoag noa, “Lazarus, toowow!”
A toowow, nge e rhiuwen tiugiutiug noa rhag paiun me pirheen reen mengaag iwe epwan yor mengaag tiugiutiug ngaeni mesan. Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw pwaeisi noa nge oawwa nigiti noa.”
Aar Rhiu Aenneewa Jesus
Towunepeer rhooawe re itto reen Maria ra weri meeta we Jesus efeeori, iwe ra niugiuniug ngaeni.
Iwe nge aekkaerhai iir ra noa ngaeniir Pharisees kkewe iwe ra aengaeniir meeta kkewe Jesus efeeori.
Iwe Pharisees me soamwooniir patere kkewe ra rhungaeni council we iwe ra iura pwe, “Meeta sipwene feeori? Oaw pipiiy oanongaen kkeman kka mwaaeneei a feeorin!
Ngaere igine sipwe nigiti noa rhag pwe epwe ieei wusun, oanongeer aeremas nge repwene niugiuniug ngaeni, nge manekka soamwoonin Rome repwe itto fereei noa Temple e aarh me minne faniuwarh!”
Erhai me neeiir itan Caiaphas, iiy miniwe Soamwoonin Patere noan raeg we, a iura pwe, “A inamwo pwurhomi!
Oawse giuneei pwe egacch ngaenigaemi igine erhai emae noa faaen iteer rhooa towunap, mmwaen igine oanongeer aeremas repwe toaroporop noa?”
Ese tipan rhag wooan oanongan pwe epwe aepesa minneei; pwe iga iiy miniwe Soamwoonin Patere noan raeg naan, iwe e aepesa pwe Jesus epwe mae noa faaen iteer re Jews,
nge saapw faaen iteer rhag, pwe pwan minni epwe oarhuur nong rhag noan eew tipieew oanongeer aeremas kka naiun Deus ikka re meganagan fetaen.
Saengi raaenin we a noa, soamwooniir Jews kkewe ra feeori noa aar niunniuwaen pwe repwe niiy noa Jesus.
Iwe Jesus esa pwaeri noano aan faaeraeg fetaen me wooan Judea, iwe a noa reen eew pwiuneoi iwe eno oaron desert we, reen eew aepinoamw itan Ephraim, a noa no ee iiy me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun.
Oaton gupwunon Passover we a arapeto, re towunap aeremesaen aepinoamw kkewe ra maegeto Jerusalem pwe repwe itto feeori engaengaen aenimenimen weni mmwaen gupwun we.
Ra kiukkiutta Jesus, nge igiwe ra rhu me noan Temple we ra aeiineo fengaen wooar pwe, “Meeta oaw maengiy? Ennetaen esoapw itto tapweei gupwun eei, aere?”
Soamwoonin patere me Pharisees kkewe ra fasiun aetiwenig ngaeniir aeremas pwe aere yor e eweri Jesus, nge a iura, pwe repwe noa torofi.
